title: Deliver Iron Ore to Sinningpool Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Sinningpool Steel Mill** (industry id 44, near tile 94,204).

A likely supplier is **Brudinghead Cross Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 40, near tile 88,223); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **340 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
